narrative.intro: Bath Iron Works obligated $2.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bath Iron Works received 19 awards so far, with an average award size of $112M. Bath Iron Works obligations are down 10.3% year over year. Bath Iron Works remains concentrated in Ship Building and Repairing, which accounted for $2.1B of obligations in FY2026 to date. Bath Iron Works fiscal-year history shows a rise from $1B in FY21 to $2.1B in FY23 and FY24, a peak of $2.4B in FY25, and a return to $2.1B in FY26. Bath Iron Works has smaller obligations in several other NAICS markets, including Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing at $37.6K, Convention and Trade Show Organizers at $27K, and Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing at $25.5K. Bath Iron Works performance this fiscal year is a partial total because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.

sections.heading: Who are Bath Iron Works' largest markets and how have obligations trended?
sections.body: Ship Building and Repairing is the largest market for Bath Iron Works, with $2.1B in obligations in FY2026 to date. Bath Iron Works obligations rose from $1B in FY21 to $2.4B in FY25, then moved to $2.1B in FY26. Bath Iron Works has much smaller obligations in several other NAICS categories, including $37.6K in Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing.

sections.heading: What types of products and services does Bath Iron Works provide to the federal government?
sections.body: Bath Iron Works sells shipbuilding and ship repair services to the federal government, reflected by $2.1B in Ship Building and Repairing obligations in FY2026 to date. Bath Iron Works also has small contract activity in related and ancillary manufacturing and services, including $27K for Convention and Trade Show Organizers and $25.5K for Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing.
